name: Test Runner
soul: The soul of no one: a test runner, kept for the engine's tests only.
spark: A test mote, kept for the engine's tests only.

hybrid.text: It is a test of the test runner.

settled.name: Small test runner
settled.text: A test settled form of the test runner, kept for the engine's tests only.
settled.sign: A stranger would notice the mark of Small test runner on it.
settled.habit: When nothing is happening, Small test runner counts to itself.
